scope: WSL2 Linux x86_64 project-local gitleaks and Worktrunk synthetic qualification
checks: Verify official archive, publisher checksum and pinned license bytes before native execution.
Default gitleaks rules detect exactly one generated inert github-pat fixture with exit 1, fully redacted reports and logs.
A clean synthetic directory returns exit 0 and an empty gitleaks JSON report.
Native Worktrunk creates and lists two named worktrees at owned paths from the frozen local main commit.
Native Worktrunk removes the clean tree in the foreground without force.
Native Worktrunk refuses removal of modified and untracked synthetic data; bytes and registration remain intact.
After reverting only fixture-authored bytes, native non-force removal succeeds; native list and Git agree only main remains.
Explicit --no-hooks suppresses fixture project hooks; no model, remote, user config or global changes.
failure_policy: Retain logs and any remaining owned worktrees on failure; never force-delete changes or silently rerun.
usage: No model/provider invocation in fixture; enclosing coordinator and child usage unknown; no savings claim.
